words.definition: adj. 强制的，义务的；（课程）必修的

examples.en: The law made primary education compulsory for all children.
examples.zh: 该法律规定所有儿童必须接受初等教育。

examples.en: Attendance at the safety training is compulsory for new employees.
examples.zh: 新员工必须参加安全培训。

words.usage: 「义务教育」compulsory education；compulsory subjects（必修课）与 elective subjects（选修课）相对。派生：compulsion n. 强制。
words.mnemonic: com+puls(推)+ory→推着做的→强制的、义务的

words.definition: n. 附录；阑尾

examples.en: Full experimental data are given in the appendix to this paper.
examples.zh: 完整的实验数据见本文附录。

examples.en: The surgeon decided to remove the patient's appendix immediately.
examples.zh: 外科医生决定立即切除病人的阑尾。

words.usage: 「书的附录」多用复数 appendices；医学指「阑尾」，阑尾炎为 appendicitis。派生：append vt. 附上；appendage n. 附属物。
collocations: an appendix to the report 报告附录
in the appendix 在附录中
remove an appendix 切除阑尾
words.mnemonic: ap+pend(挂)+ix→挂在书后的→附录；挂在肠上的→阑尾

words.definition: adj. 有益健康的；（格调）健康的，向上的

examples.en: A wholesome diet and regular exercise are keys to longevity.
examples.zh: 健康的饮食和经常锻炼是长寿的关键。

examples.en: Parents prefer wholesome programs for their children.
examples.zh: 父母更偏爱适合孩子观看的格调健康的节目。

words.usage: 修饰食物、生活方式：wholesome food（健康食品）；也指「格调健康的」：wholesome entertainment。派生：wholesomely adv.；反义 harmful。
collocations: a wholesome lifestyle 健康的生活方式
words.mnemonic: whole(健康)+some(形容词后缀)→有益健康的

words.definition: n. 亚麻布；日用织品（床单、桌布）

examples.en: The hotel irons all its table linen every morning.
examples.zh: 酒店每天早上熨烫全部桌布餐巾。

examples.en: This shirt is made of pure linen, cool and comfortable.
examples.zh: 这件衬衫是纯亚麻的，凉爽舒适。

words.usage: 不可数名词「亚麻布」；table linen（桌布餐巾）；习语 wash your dirty linen in public（家丑外扬）。原料为 flax（亚麻）。
collocations: wash one's dirty linen in public 家丑外扬
words.mnemonic: line(线)+n→织线之布→亚麻布

words.definition: n. 拱门，拱形结构；v. （使）成弓形

examples.en: The ancient stone arch has stood for nearly a thousand years.
examples.zh: 这座古老的石拱门已屹立近千年。

examples.en: The cat arched its back at the sight of the dog.
examples.zh: 猫一见到狗就弓起了背。

words.usage: 名词「拱门」：the arch of a bridge（桥拱）；动词 arch one's back（弓起背）。前缀 arch- 表「首要」：archenemy（头号敌人）。
collocations: the arch of the foot 足弓
arch one's eyebrows 扬起眉毛
words.mnemonic: architect(建筑师)中有arch→拱；arch-表「首要」

words.definition: n. 邮轮，客轮；衬里，内衬

examples.en: The Titanic was the largest ocean liner of its time.
examples.zh: 泰坦尼克号是当时最大的远洋邮轮。

examples.en: The jacket has a detachable wool liner for winter.
examples.zh: 这件夹克带有可拆卸的羊毛内衬，供冬天使用。

words.usage: 指「按固定航线航行的大客船」：an ocean liner（远洋邮轮）；亦指衣物「衬里」。源自 line（航线）。近义 cruise ship 侧重游乐。
collocations: an ocean liner 远洋邮轮
a luxury liner 豪华邮轮
a coat liner 外套内衬
words.mnemonic: line(航线)+(e)r→走固定航线的船→邮轮；亦指衬里

words.definition: n. 二氧化物

examples.en: Burning fossil fuels releases enormous amounts of carbon dioxide.
examples.zh: 燃烧化石燃料会释放大量二氧化碳。

examples.en: Trees absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.
examples.zh: 树木吸收二氧化碳并释放氧气。

words.usage: 多用于复合词：carbon dioxide（二氧化碳）与 sulfur dioxide（二氧化硫）；环保阅读常考 carbon dioxide emissions。di- 表「二」。

confusables.note: 氧化物；缺 di- 前缀

collocations: carbon dioxide emissions 二氧化碳排放
words.mnemonic: di(二)+oxide(氧化物)→二氧化物；carbon dioxide二氧化碳

words.definition: n. 缩微模型，微型画；adj. 微型的

examples.en: The museum displays a miniature of the ancient capital.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了古都的微缩模型。

examples.en: The toy town is the real city in miniature.
examples.zh: 这座玩具小镇就是真实城市的缩影。

words.usage: 名词「微缩模型」；形容词「微型的」；in miniature（小规模地、缩影式地）。重音在第一音节，勿读错。派生：miniaturize vt. 使微型化。
collocations: a miniature model 微缩模型
a miniature camera 微型相机
words.mnemonic: mini(小)+ature→微型的；mini-同源如miniskirt

words.definition: n. （分期付款的）一期付款；（连载的）一集

examples.en: Many young people buy apartments by monthly installments.
examples.zh: 许多年轻人按月分期付款购买公寓。

examples.en: The second installment of the series will appear next month.
examples.zh: 该系列的第二期将于下月刊登。

words.usage: 「分期付款」pay by/in installments（英式拼法 instalment）；「连载的一集」a novel in installments。常配 monthly installments。
collocations: pay by installments 分期付款
a novel in installments 连载小说
words.mnemonic: install(安置)+ment→一期期安置付款→分期付款

words.definition: n. 矿物；矿物质；adj. 矿物的

examples.en: The country is rich in mineral resources such as copper and iron.
examples.zh: 该国铜、铁等矿产资源丰富。

examples.en: Athletes lose vitamins and minerals through sweating.
examples.zh: 运动员出汗会流失维生素和矿物质。

words.usage: mineral resources（矿产资源）、mineral water（矿泉水）为高频搭配。同族：mine n. 矿；miner n. 矿工。可作定语。
collocations: vitamins and minerals 维生素与矿物质
words.mnemonic: mine(矿)+eral→矿中所得→矿物；mineral water矿泉水

words.definition: n. 最小值，最低限度；adj. 最小的

examples.en: The factory has cut raw material use to a minimum.
examples.zh: 工厂已把原材料消耗降到最低。

examples.en: Employers must comply with the minimum wage law.
examples.zh: 雇主必须遵守最低工资法。

words.usage: at a minimum（至少）；keep sth to a minimum（把…压到最低）；复数 minima。反义 maximum。派生：minimal adj. 极小的；minimize vt. 最小化。
collocations: keep costs to a minimum 把成本降到最低
words.mnemonic: mini(小)+mum→最小值；maxi+mum→maximum最大

words.definition: adj. 复合的，合成的；n. 合成物，复合材料

examples.en: Modern aircraft widely use lightweight composite materials.
examples.zh: 现代飞机广泛使用轻质复合材料。

examples.en: The police released a composite picture of the suspect.
examples.zh: 警方公布了嫌疑人的合成画像。

words.usage: composite materials（复合材料）科技阅读高频；a composite index（综合指数）。派生：compose vt. 组成；composition n. 构成，作文。
collocations: a composite photograph 合成照片
a composite index 综合指数
words.mnemonic: com(共)+pos(放)+ite→放在一起的→复合的

words.definition: n. 拷打，酷刑；折磨；vt. 拷问；使痛苦

examples.en: The report documented cases of torture in the prison.
examples.zh: 报告记录了监狱中的酷刑案例。

examples.en: The slow internet connection was pure torture for the students.
examples.zh: 缓慢的网络对学生来说简直是煎熬。

words.usage: 「受折磨」suffer torture；比喻义 the torture of waiting（等待的煎熬）。派生：torturous adj. 折磨人的；torturer n. 施刑者。词根 tort「扭」。
collocations: the torture of waiting 等待的煎熬
words.mnemonic: tort(扭)+ure→拷打得扭曲→酷刑；distort扭曲同根

words.definition: n. 急流，洪流；（感情、言辞的）迸发

examples.en: The bridge was swept away by a mountain torrent.
examples.zh: 那座桥被山洪冲走了。

examples.en: The manager faced a torrent of criticism after the decision.
examples.zh: 决定公布后，经理遭到铺天盖地的批评。

words.usage: 自然义 torrents of rain（倾盆大雨）；比喻义 a torrent of abuse（连珠炮似的责骂）。派生：torrential adj. 倾泻的：torrential rain 暴雨。
collocations: a torrent of abuse 劈头盖脸的责骂
words.mnemonic: 谐音「滔」→滔滔急流；torrential rain倾盆大雨

words.definition: adj. 瞬间的，即刻的；同时发生的

examples.en: The new payment system allows instantaneous settlement of transactions.
examples.zh: 新支付系统可实现交易的即时结算。

examples.en: Social media has created a culture of instantaneous feedback.
examples.zh: 社交媒体造就了即时反馈的文化。

words.usage: instantaneous response（即时响应）科技语域常见；比 instant 更书面，强调「瞬间发生」。派生：instantaneously adv. 立即地。
words.mnemonic: instant(立即)+aneous→一瞬间的；同后缀simultaneous

words.definition: adj. 同种类的，同质的；均匀的

examples.en: The city's population is far from homogeneous in culture.
examples.zh: 这座城市的人口在文化上远非单一。

examples.en: Mix the two liquids until the solution is homogeneous.
examples.zh: 将两种液体混合至溶液均匀为止。

words.usage: a homogeneous group（同质群体）；反义 heterogeneous（异质的）。派生：homogeneity n. 同质；homogenize vt. 使均质。词根 homo「相同」。
collocations: a homogeneous group 同质群体
a homogeneous society 单一同质的社会
words.mnemonic: homo(同)+gene(种)+ous→同种类的；hetero表异

words.definition: vt. 承认（属实）；让与；vi. 认输，让步

examples.en: The candidate conceded defeat once the results were announced.
examples.zh: 结果公布后，候选人承认了失败。

examples.en: Officials conceded that the policy had failed to achieve its goals.
examples.zh: 官员们承认该政策未能实现目标。

words.usage: concede defeat（承认失败）；concede that 从句（承认…）；辩论中 concede a point（让一步）。派生：concession n. 让步，特许。强调不情愿。
words.mnemonic: con(完全)+cede(让)→全让出→让步；勉强承认

words.definition: n. 姓名地址录，电话簿；目录

examples.en: You can find his number in the telephone directory.
examples.zh: 你可以在电话簿里找到他的号码。

examples.en: Save the file in the root directory of the disk.
examples.zh: 请把文件保存在磁盘根目录下。

words.usage: a telephone directory（电话簿）；计算机「目录」亦用此词。派生同根：direct vt. 指引。注意与 direction（方向）区分拼写。
words.mnemonic: direct(指引)+ory(物)→指引查询的册子→名录

words.definition: v. 蘸，浸；下降；n. 蘸；短暂下跌；短泳

examples.en: He dipped the brush into the paint and began to work.
examples.zh: 他把刷子蘸进颜料，开始作画。

examples.en: Profits dipped sharply during the economic recession.
examples.zh: 经济衰退期间利润大幅下滑。

words.usage: dip sth in/into（把…蘸入）；dip into one's pocket（掏腰包）；dip into a book（翻阅）。数值下跌：sales dip（销量下滑）。
collocations: dip into one's pocket 掏腰包
a dip in prices 价格下跌
go for a dip 去泡水游泳
words.mnemonic: 联想tip(尖)：笔尖dip进墨水→蘸、浸

words.definition: n. 隔间，车厢；分隔层

examples.en: The luggage rack in our compartment was already full.
examples.zh: 我们车厢的行李架已经满了。

examples.en: Keep the first-aid kit in a separate compartment of the backpack.
examples.zh: 把急救包放在背包的独立隔层里。

words.usage: 列车「包厢、车厢」：a first-class compartment；车内 glove compartment（杂物箱）。派生：compartmentalize vt. 分隔处理。词根 part。
collocations: a first-class compartment 头等车厢
the glove compartment 汽车杂物箱
a separate compartment 独立隔间
words.mnemonic: com+part(部分)+ment→隔成小部分→隔间、车厢
